cases.translation: Why are we counted as animals?
cases.explain: The verb считаются (to count) takes the accusative case for the predicate noun.

cases.translation: Will the earth be forsaken for you?
cases.explain: Земля is the subject of the verb опустеть (to be forsaken), requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Свет у нечестивого погаснет, даже искра не останется в ___.
cases.translation: The light of the wicked will go out, not even a spark will remain in his tent.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: A snare will take him by the heel.
cases.explain: Петля is the subject of the verb поймает, standing in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Сократится мощь его шагов, и падет он жертвой своих же замыслов и ___ его.
cases.translation: The strength of his steps will be shortened.
cases.explain: The word жертвой (victim) in genitive construction requires genitive for the possessive 'of his fire.'

cases.sentence: Память о нем исчезнет с ___, и не будут о нем вспоминать.
cases.translation: His memory will disappear from the earth, and he will not be remembered.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Никого не останется после него в ___ его.
cases.translation: No one will be left after him among his people.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing location requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Да, таков беззаконного ___, вместо того, кто не знает Бога.
cases.translation: Indeed, such is the house of the unrighteous, instead of one who does not know God.
cases.explain: Дом is the subject complement, standing in nominative case.

reading.ru: Когда ты положишь конец речам, подумай, потом будем говорить.
reading.question: What does Bildad suggest Job should do before continuing?
reading.explain: Bildad tells Job to положишь конец речам (stop talking) and подумай (think) before they continue speaking.

reading.ru: Истинно свет у нечестивого погаснет, даже искра не останется.
reading.question: What happens to the light of the wicked?
reading.explain: The text states свет у нечестивого погаснет (the light of the wicked will go out).

reading.ru: Ноги его сами шагнут в силки, запутаются в сетях ловца.
reading.question: How does the wicked man meet his fate?
options: Through his own steps falling into traps
reading.correct: Through his own steps falling into traps
reading.explain: The verse describes how ноги его сами шагнут в силки (his own feet step into snares).

reading.ru: Страшат его ужасы отовсюду, следуют за ним по пятам.
reading.question: What pursues the wicked man according to this verse?
reading.explain: The text says ужасы отовсюду (terrors from all sides) follow him at his heels.

reading.ru: В шатре его поселится пламя, горящая сера изольется на его жилище.
reading.question: What destructive elements will dwell in the wicked man's tent?
reading.explain: The text describes пламя (fire) and горящая сера (burning sulfur) in his tent.

reading.ru: Память о нем исчезнет с земли, и не будут о нем вспоминать на улицах.
reading.question: What will happen to the wicked man's memory?
options: It will disappear from the earth and be forgotten
It will be honored in the streets
It will be preserved in history
reading.correct: It will disappear from the earth and be forgotten
reading.explain: The text says память о нем исчезнет (his memory will disappear) and не будут о нем вспоминать (he will not be remembered).
